beaches.name: Tropical coast
beaches.description: Slow down beside turquoise water and pale sand. Make time for a coastal walk, a quiet afternoon and the changing colors of the sea.
beaches.imageAlt: White sandy tropical beach and clear turquoise sea

beaches.name: Island shoreline
beaches.description: Discover an island beach framed by palm trees and open water. Enjoy a relaxed shoreline walk and take in the ocean views.
beaches.imageAlt: Scenic beach with a sweeping shoreline

temples.name: Angkor Wat
temples.description: Explore the monumental temple complex and its detailed stone carvings. Discover Khmer history and the quiet spaces around the temple grounds.

temples.name: Temple gardens of Kyoto
temples.description: Discover Kyoto's temple traditions, garden paths and carefully preserved architecture. Take time to observe local customs and enjoy a reflective visit.
temples.imageAlt: Traditional temple and architecture in Japan

countries.name: Australia
countries.description: Explore Sydney's harbor, coastal walks and lively neighborhoods. Australia's landscapes offer a starting point for journeys through cities, coast and countryside.
countries.imageAlt: Sydney Opera House and harbor in Australia

countries.name: Japan
countries.description: Discover a country of historic streets, temple gardens and bustling cities. Build an itinerary around regional food, local traditions and thoughtful exploration.
